contentBlocks.text: How to Appeal an SRD R370 Grant Decline

The SRD R370 grant operates differently from other SASSA grants. Because eligibility is reassessed every month, you may find that one month is approved and the next is declined. This guide covers the specific process for appealing SRD grant declines.

items: Each month is assessed independently based on that month's bank statements and database checks
You must appeal EACH declined month separately — one appeal does not cover all months
The appeal portal for SRD is srd.dsd.gov.za (separate from other SASSA appeals)
Backpay is calculated per approved month, not as a lump sum

steps.title: Log into the SRD appeal portal
steps.description: Go to srd.dsd.gov.za. Enter your ID number and the phone number used during your original SRD application.

steps.title: Request and enter OTP
steps.description: An OTP will be sent to your phone. Enter it to verify your identity.

steps.title: Select the declined month
steps.description: You will see a list of all months you applied for. Select the specific month(s) showing 'Declined'.

steps.title: Choose your appeal reason
steps.description: Select the reason that matches your situation from the dropdown menu.

steps.title: Upload supporting evidence
steps.description: Upload documents that support your appeal (bank statements, affidavit, UIF/NSFAS letters).

steps.title: Submit and save reference
steps.description: Submit the appeal. Save the Appeal Reference Number — you will need it to track progress.

contentBlocks.title: Important: Appeal Every Month
contentBlocks.text: If you have multiple declined months, you must submit a separate appeal for each month. A single appeal only covers one month.

If your appeal is upheld, you will receive backpay for that specific month at the rate of R370. Payments are processed within 14 business days of the tribunal ruling. Each approved month is paid separately.

faqs.question: Do I need to appeal every month the SRD grant is declined?
faqs.answer: Yes. Because SASSA reassesses eligibility monthly, each declined month needs its own appeal. There is no way to appeal all months at once.

faqs.question: Can I appeal if I already received payment for some months but not others?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can appeal the specific months that were declined even if other months were approved.

faqs.question: How long does an SRD appeal take?
faqs.answer: The standard ITSAA timeline applies: 60-90 days from submission to ruling.
